caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing figure on a rectangular gray pedestal with a broken piece under its left foot. The figure is dressed in a tunic-like garment predominantly colored brown and green, with a fringed sash and decorative bands across the body and around the upper arms. The figure’s skin tone is medium brown. The figure’s left arm is bent at the elbow and held at the forehead as if shielding the eyes, while the right hand holds a cylindrical object vertically against the thigh. On the head, the figure wears a large headdress composed of three feathers in shades of brown, beige, and gray, along with a green band wrapping around the head. The figure’s footwear are brown sandals with green straps. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no other objects or details present.
title: Cigar Store Indian
